course_position.stage_name: Solid B1+ to Low B2 Development

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Support an opinion with a concrete example using till exempel and det märks när.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Comparing remote and in-person routines for work, study, appointments, or courses.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Adding an example that makes a viewpoint more convincing and less repetitive.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss when remote routines work well and when meeting in person is better.

main_focus.name: examples with till exempel and det märks när
main_focus.description: Use example phrases to support a claim with a concrete situation from everyday routines.
model_examples: Till exempel blir det lättare att fokusera hemma på morgonen.
Det märks när man behöver ställa många frågor.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 3-4 example phrases, each tied directly to an opinion or contrast.

allowed_supporting_grammar: opinion frames with tycker att or anser att
condition clauses with när or om
modal verbs for preference and need

useful_chunks: På plats är det lättare att...
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use example chunks so the opinion becomes specific but still short.

dialogue_shape.opening: A choice between remote and in-person routines is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They state preferences and add concrete examples that show when each option works best.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree that the better option depends on the situation.

target_complexity.repetition: Examples should clarify the opinion, not expand into a long monologue.

focus: the situations where remote or in-person routines work better
the example that supports the main viewpoint
the condition that changes which option is preferred

sentence_focus: one sentence with det märks när
one sentence comparing distans and på plats
one sentence with det beror på situationen
one sentence supporting a preference with an example
